sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण सौमित्रिः पुनरब्रवीत् ।तृप्तिराश्चर्यभूतानां कथानां नास्ति मे नृप ।। ७.५५.२ ॥
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa saumitriḥ punarabravīt ।tṛptirāścaryabhūtānāṁ kathānāṁ nāsti me nṛpa ।। 7.55.2 ॥

translations.english: But thus spoken to by Rama, Saumitri spoke again, saying, "O king, I have no satisfaction from wonderful stories."
